|game_text=If an [A New Hope] objective on table, deploy on table. Twice per game, may ▲ Mon Mothma or any general. During your first turn, while Stolen Data Tapes at Dune Sea, [Set 1] Obi-Wan deploys -6 there. [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history={{Card errata/Strike Planning (V)}}
The [[Strike Planning (V) (Errata 2)|December 2024 erratum]] changed the deployment condition, the leaders the card can take into hand, and the deployment benefit.<ref name="strike-planning-december-errata">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata_2024_12_30.pdf December 2024 errata sheet], p. 7. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261117192504id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata_2024_12_30.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
This is the original printing of “Strike Planning (V)” in Virtual Modern (version 1 of 2): the card image in place when Virtual Set 21 was officially released (18 June 2023). The current text is [[Strike Planning (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Original''' (this page): the card image at official release (5 March 2023)<ref name="ht-53a6001">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/53a600169f2a3fd1b105ba01f85cef84edcd22bd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/strikeplanning.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/strikeplanning.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/53a600169f2a3fd1b105ba01f85cef84edcd22bd 53a6001] “Virtual Set 21 Preview Cards”, 5 March 2023.</ref> prints: “If an [A New Hope] objective on table, deploy on table. Twice per game, may ▲ Mon Mothma or any general. During your first turn, while Stolen Data Tapes at Dune Sea, [Set 1] Obi-Wan deploys -6 there. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-6e6f7f7">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/6e6f7f7 swccg-card-json commit 6e6f7f7] “Set 21 Preview and Errata” (5 March 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
*: The same card face was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 6, with the same words. Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip and that card image are one version on this page; the former page ''Strike Planning (V) (Errata)'' redirects there.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Strike Planning (V) (Errata 2)]]): the errata card image (29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/strikeplanning.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/strikeplanning.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata.</ref> prints: “If Rebel Strike Team on table, deploy on table. Unless opponent’s [Endor] objective on table, opponent generates no Force at your Endor system. Twice per game, may ▲ an [Endor] or [Death Star II] leader. May ▼ [Death Star II] ''Falcon'' to Endor system. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-304ab4f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/304ab4f swccg-card-json commit 304ab4f] “Set 24” (29 December 2024) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The deploy condition “If an [A New Hope] objective on table” became “If Rebel Strike Team on table”; “Unless opponent’s [Endor] objective on table, opponent generates no Force at your Endor system.” was added; the twice-per-game ▲ (take into hand from Reserve Deck) changed from “Mon Mothma or any general” to “an [Endor] or [Death Star II] leader”; the first-turn [Set 1] Obi-Wan deploy −6 at Dune Sea was replaced by “May ▼ [Death Star II] ''Falcon'' to Endor system.” (▼ = deploy from Reserve Deck). The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
